AddNazim.intro: A köşk nazımı runs the köşk and its courses. Whoever you add becomes {koskGenitive} köşk nazımı right away.
AddNazim.title: Add a köşk nazımı
Changes.note: Hiding the köşk takes it and all its courses out of every list; nobody but its köşk nazımları, the Medaris başnazımı and the Medaris nazımları holding platform.kosk_edit can open it. Nothing is deleted; the level that hid it or a higher one brings it back: a köşk nazımı what they hid, Medaris management anything hidden. Taking it out of service, on the numbers you read in the preview, takes every köşk nazımı off the post at once and closes the content of the courses under the köşk to the talebe; nothing is hidden or deleted, and the köşk is active again once a köşk nazımı is added. Adding köşk nazımları makes the people chosen köşk nazımları at once (until the end, if one is given). Every action is written to the audit log; no screen takes a köşk nazımı off the post.

Manage.restoreBody: The köşk returns to the lists with its courses; talebe and visitors can open it again.
